Microsoft's FY2025 Q4 revenue was $76.441 billion, calculated as the sum of Product revenue ($17.136 billion) and Service and other revenue ($59.305 billion) for the three months ended June 30, 2025. [ER25Q4:pressreleasecontent:efcf79be3d45acce] [ER25Q4:pressreleasecontent:645de3243c9951a7]
